home.question: What would you like to do?

new.title: New communication
new.description: Start from a document, a text or a template.

existing.title: Existing communication
existing.description: Resume, follow up or duplicate from history.

todo.title: To do
todo.blocked: {count, plural, =0 {None blocked} one {# blocked} other {# blocked}}
todo.approval: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to approve} one {# to approve} other {# to approve}}
todo.inProgress: {count, plural, =0 {None in progress} one {# in progress} other {# in progress}}

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Your communications by stage, what awaits your approval, what is blocked.

empty.title: You have no communication in progress
empty.description: A communication starts with its framing: nature, criticality, scope, language and input mode.

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.empty: None of your communications is blocked.
blocked.CONTRADICTION_NON_TRANCHEE: {count, plural, one {One contradiction between sources to resolve} other {# contradictions between sources to resolve}}

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Sent, pending, rejected and approval rate, by persona and format.

empty.title: Indicators will come from real sends
empty.description: They will appear here once communications have been approved and sent: no figure is estimated.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: AI models, personas, mailing lists and templates.

models.title: AI models
models.description: Provider and model, per agent. Keys stay in the vault.

personas.title: Personas
personas.description: Tone, level of detail, angle and length for each audience.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The requested address does not match any page. Check the link or return to the dashboard.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: The application could not display this page. No data was changed. You can try again.

design.title: Design system
design.description: ComGen's foundations and components, in their real state. This page is the visual reference and the accessibility test bench.

colors.title: Colours
colors.intro: One accent hue. Every other colour carries a meaning and nothing else: success, warning, error.

typography.title: Typography
typography.intro: Fixed scale from 14 px. Every size is paired with its line height.
typography.sample: Versions, dates and identifiers are copied, never regenerated.
typography.mono: Identifiers and versions in monospace: INC-2025-0342, v4.2.1

spacing.title: Spacing and shape
spacing.intro: 4 px grid. Deliberately small radii: separation comes from the border, not the shadow.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.intro: A single primary action per view. Destructive actions are always named.

fields.title: Fields
fields.intro: Label above, hint below, error after the hint. A field in error is announced to screen readers.
fields.subjectHint: As it will appear in the sent email.
fields.audienceHint: One list per persona. Recipients are validated at send time.
fields.audienceError: The audience “Tier 2 suppliers” no longer exists in the directory.

badges.title: State badges
badges.intro: Every state has a shape and a text. Colour reinforces, it is never the only signal.

notices.title: Messages
notices.intro: Three levels. The blocking level always explains what is missing and what to do.

info.title: Extraction complete
info.body: 12 facts were extracted from the source. Validate them before generating.

warning.title: Incomplete register
warning.body: The “reassuring” tone has no equivalent for German. The German variant will use the default register.

blocking.title: Sending blocked: 2 assertions without supporting fact
blocking.body: Assertions A-07 and A-11 are not linked to any fact in the fact sheet. Link them to an existing fact or remove them from the variant.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.intro: For parallel views of the same object, never for sequential steps.

table.title: Table
table.intro: Numbers right-aligned in tabular figures. The whole row is clickable; the sorted header is announced.

progress.title: Progress
progress.intro: Always accompanied by a label and a numeric value.
progress.label: Generating variants

screenStates.emptyDescription: Upload a document, an email or a ticket to extract its facts.
screenStates.errorDescription: The data service did not respond. Your drafts are intact.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Identify yourself to access your organisation's communications.

oidc.title: Corporate account
oidc.description: Authentication through your organisation's identity provider.

simulator.title: Demo account
simulator.description: Development environment: pick an account from the demo data set. No password. This mode is refused in production.
simulator.hint: The roles shown are those stored in the database; they are re-read on every request.

none.title: No sign-in method configured
none.description: Declare an OIDC provider (AUTH_OIDC_ISSUER, AUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_ID, AUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET) or, outside production, AUTH_SIMULATEUR=true.

compte-inconnu.title: Unknown account
compte-inconnu.description: This account does not exist in the application directory or is disabled. No session was opened.

generique.title: Sign-in refused
generique.description: The identity provider did not confirm your identity, or your account is not known to the application.

list.title: History
list.description: Every communication in your organisation, most recent first.

empty.title: No communications
empty.description: Nothing has been framed in your organisation yet.

list.caption: Organisation communications

criticitesDescriptions.CRITIQUE: Major impact; dual approval and a cancellation window.

modesDescriptions.FICHIER: Word, PDF, Excel, CSV, Markdown or text documents, uploaded and read on the server.
modesDescriptions.TEXTE_SAISI: You write the message; it becomes the source.
modesDescriptions.CONNECTEUR: Fetch a ticket or a release note by its reference.
modesDescriptions.COURRIEL: An email forwarded to an intake address.
modesDescriptions.DICTEE: A transcribed recording, reviewed then validated.
modesDescriptions.API: A draft created by a third-party tool.
modesDescriptions.FORMULAIRE: A questionnaire specific to the communication's nature.

cadrage.title: New communication
cadrage.description: The framing sets what is communicated, to whom and how strictly it is checked. Nothing is guessed: every field is declared.

titre.label: Title
titre.hint: The subject in one line, as it will appear in lists.

parentId.label: Original communication
parentId.hint: For an update, a correction or a reminder. The original stays unchanged.

steps.title: Steps
steps.entreeDescription: Upload files or type the source text.
steps.ficheDescription: Review each fact against its quotation and resolve contradictions.

transitions.title: Move forward
transitions.description: Every step is checked on the server; a refusal states everything that is missing.
transitions.none: No manual transition from this state.

toState.PRETE_A_GENERER: Mark the fact sheet as validated

entree.title: Source input
entree.description: Each source is frozen on input: text read on the server, fingerprint, detected language. The facts found in it remain to be reviewed.

closed.title: Sources are frozen
closed.description: The communication has moved past the input stage; a new source requires a follow-up.

files.title: Upload files
files.description: Up to 20 files, 25 MiB each, 50 MiB in total. Read formats: .docx, .pdf (with text), .xlsx, .csv, .md, .txt.
files.label: Files
files.hint: .pptx, .eml, .msg and images (OCR) are not read yet: they are refused and reported.
files.drop: Choose files or drag them here
files.selected: {count, plural, one {# file chosen} other {# files chosen}}

text.title: Type the text
text.description: The typed text becomes a source, word for word. Variants cannot add anything to it.

confidentiality.label: Source confidentiality
confidentiality.hint: Inherited by the facts found; can be changed fact by fact.

result.title: Upload result
result.deposited: {count, plural, one {# fact found} other {# facts found}}

antivirusOff.title: No antivirus scan
antivirusOff.description: This environment is configured without an antivirus (ANTIVIRUS_MODE=aucun). The files were read without being scanned.

motifs.FORMAT_INCOHERENT: The content does not match the file extension.
motifs.FORMAT_NON_PRIS_EN_CHARGE: This format is not read yet (presentations, emails, images).
motifs.TEXTE_ABSENT: No readable text: a scanned PDF requires character recognition, not available yet.
motifs.INFECTE: Threat detected by the antivirus ({detail}). The file was not kept.
motifs.ANTIVIRUS_INDISPONIBLE: The antivirus does not respond: the file was not accepted. Try again later.
motifs.EN_DOUBLE: This content is already a source of this communication.
motifs.NOM_INVALIDE: Empty or overly long file name.

fiche.title: Fact sheet
fiche.description: Each fact is quoted word for word from its source. Confirm what is right, remove the rest, name facts to bring them together. A value is corrected only through a justified amendment.

frozen.title: Fact sheet frozen
frozen.description: The communication has moved past fact validation.

fiche.readOnly: Read only: your role does not allow changes to the fact sheet.

empty.title: No facts found
empty.description: Facts appear here as soon as a source is uploaded.

contradictions.title: {count, plural, one {A contradiction between sources blocks progress} other {# contradictions between sources block progress}}
contradictions.description: Two sources give different values for the same fact. Remove the wrong fact, or amend its value and justify the choice.

fact.assumed: Value declared under its author's responsibility.

actions.renameHint: The statement is the fact's label; two facts with the same statement and different values contradict each other.
actions.amendHint: The quotation stays the source's; the amendment is recorded and visible to approvers.
actions.justificationHint: Why this value? At least ten characters.
actions.invokedSourceHint: Document, message or person establishing the value.
actions.assume: I take responsibility for this value without a source: the fact becomes “declared” and requires an approval.

add.title: Add a fact
add.description: Copy the exact quotation from the source text; the value must appear in it as is.
add.valeurHint: Copied from the quotation, character for character. Empty for a statement without value.

sourcePanel.title: Source texts
sourcePanel.description: Quotations of live facts are highlighted.

next.title: Validate the fact sheet
next.description: The fact sheet is validated once every fact is reviewed and contradictions are resolved. Persona selection follows.

motifs.TRANSITION_INCONNUE: This step does not exist from the current state.
motifs.FAIT_NON_REVU: Some facts remain to be reviewed: confirm or remove them.
motifs.CONTRADICTION_NON_TRANCHEE: A contradiction between sources is not resolved.
motifs.AUCUN_PERSONA: No persona is selected: persona selection is not available in this version yet.
motifs.CONTROLE_BLOQUANT_NON_RESOLU: A blocking check is not resolved.
motifs.APPROBATIONS_INSUFFISANTES: The required approvals are not met.
motifs.LISTE_DIFFUSION_NON_RESOLUE: A distribution list is not resolved.

erreurs.INTROUVABLE: This item does not exist or does not belong to your organisation.
erreurs.ETAT_INCOMPATIBLE: The current state does not allow this operation.
erreurs.TRANSITION_NON_MANUELLE: This step belongs to another flow (generation, approval, sending).
erreurs.CONFLIT: The communication was modified in the meantime. Reload the page.
erreurs.MODE_NON_DISPONIBLE: This input mode is not available yet.
erreurs.LANGUE_NON_AUTORISEE: This language is not allowed in your region.
erreurs.CITATION_INVALIDE: The quotation does not appear as is in the source.
erreurs.VALEUR_HORS_CITATION: The value does not appear as is in the quotation.
erreurs.SOURCE_EN_DOUBLE: This text is already a source of this communication.
erreurs.NON_AUTORISE: Your role does not allow this operation.

champs.trop_nombreux: Twenty files at most per upload.
champs.heure_inexistante: This time does not exist (switch to daylight saving time).
champs.heure_ambigue: This time occurs twice (end of daylight saving time): choose another one.
champs.langue_non_autorisee: Language not allowed in your region.
champs.mode_non_disponible: This mode is not available yet.
champs.appui_requis: Give a source, or take responsibility for the value.
champs.inchangee: The value is identical to the current one.
champs.en_double: This text is already a source of this communication.
champs.absente_de_la_source: This quotation does not appear word for word in the source.
champs.absente_de_la_citation: This value does not appear character for character in the quotation.
